capabilities: NIST research publications and the CSRC security-publication subset expose series, status and publication identities. The CSRC page advertises a current-publication spreadsheet and feeds.
licensing: Metadata and content rights require separate evidence; no blanket reuse license established.
limitations: No current verified item-query examples. Catalog identity and documentation do not establish qualification.
Reading availability, jurisdiction, language, native version identity and machine-use limits remain open.
next_action: Wait for a usable CSRC policy response or an explicit supported export-policy trigger before requesting its advertised XLSX/feeds. Meanwhile review general NIST metadata rights and revision semantics without assuming all government-hosted third-party works are public domain.
